edits.old: I used to keep a notebook of harbour sketches.

summary: Nothing changed. The only conversation was a single exchange in which the owner told me they had finally asked Maya for help with the mural; one remark from one person is not enough to change how I see anyone, and I could not record anything about my own part in it without inventing evidence. The harbour-sketches note expired today and I left it to drop, since no conversation below bears it out.
